description: Independent manually-reviewed source-mapping golden fixture for BioPulse active condition evidence rules.
provenance_manifest: Fixture values were manually transcribed from the primary published recommendation tables: (1) Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (Teede HJ, et al. Eur J Endocrinol/Fertil Steril/Human Reprod 2023), (2) EAU Guidelines on Sexual and Reproductive Health — Male Hypogonadism (2026), (3) Endocrine Society CPG on Testosterone Therapy (Bhasin S, et al. JCEM 2018), and (4) USDA/HHS Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2025–2030 (10th Ed, 2026). This fixture serves as an independent regression audit against production registry drift and must not be generated from code.

mappings.source_section: Chapter 1: Nutrition and Health Across the Lifespan
mappings.literal_source_verification: DGA 10th edition (2025-2030) released Jan 2026. Public health policy guideline without individual recommendation clinical GRADE/LE scores.

mappings.source_title: Testosterone Therapy in Men with Hypogonadism: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline
mappings.statement_contains: Diagnosis of male hypogonadism requires consistent symptoms and signs
mappings.literal_source_verification: Published recommendation 1.1 with native Endocrine Society rating 1 | ⊕⊕⊕O. Diagnosis requires symptoms plus unequivocally and consistently low testosterone.

mappings.source_section: Chapter 1: Nutrition and Health Across the Lifespan
mappings.statement_contains: consistent with general population dietary guidelines
mappings.literal_source_verification: General healthy eating context for adult men in evaluation pathway, sourced from national dietary guidelines. Zero fabricated EAU practice point or hormone claims.

mappings.source_title: EAU Guidelines on Sexual and Reproductive Health — Male Hypogonadism
mappings.source_recommendation_section: 3.4.3.c Summary of evidence and recommendations for choice of treatment for late-onset hypogonadism
mappings.statement_contains: Weight loss obtained through a low-calorie diet and regular physical activity
mappings.literal_source_verification: EAU 2026 Section 3.4.3.a (lifestyle discussion) and Section 3.4.3.c (Summary of evidence LE 1a; Recommendation: improve lifestyle and reduce weight, strength Strong). Strictly segregated LE from strength.

mappings.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
mappings.statement_contains: no evidence to support any one specific dietary composition over another
mappings.literal_source_verification: Teede 2023 Recommendation 3.3.1 (EBR). Certainty: Very Low (⊕◯◯◯); Strength: Conditional recommendation (❖❖❖). No superiority of any diet composition.

mappings.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
mappings.statement_contains: consistent with general population dietary guidelines
mappings.literal_source_verification: Teede 2023 Recommendation 3.3.2 (CR). Consensus recommendation for general population healthy eating tailored to individual preferences and goals.

mappings.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
mappings.statement_contains: Dietary changes should be flexible, preference-sensitive and avoid
mappings.literal_source_verification: Teede 2023 Recommendation 3.3.3 (PP). Practice point advising dietary changes be flexible, preference-sensitive, and avoid unnecessarily restrictive or unbalanced diets.

mappings.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
mappings.statement_contains: Lifestyle intervention should be recommended for all women with PCOS for improving metabolic health
mappings.literal_source_verification: Teede 2023 Recommendation 3.1.1 (EBR). Certainty: Very Low (⊕◯◯◯); Strength: Strong recommendation (❖❖❖❖). Lifestyle intervention recommended for improving metabolic health including central adiposity and lipid profile.

mappings.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
mappings.statement_contains: benefits to a healthy lifestyle even in the absence of weight loss
mappings.literal_source_verification: Teede 2023 Recommendation 3.1.5 (PP). Practice point establishing that healthy lifestyle behaviours confer health benefits even in the absence of weight loss.

mappings.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
mappings.statement_contains: For those with higher weight, weight management can be associated with clinical improvements
mappings.literal_source_verification: Teede 2023 Recommendation 3.1.6 (PP). Practice point for higher weight context. In clinical care a tailored deficit may be prescribed; BioPulse safeguards ensure neutral targets remain preserved without automated deficits.

mappings.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
mappings.statement_contains: In those who are not overweight, in adolescents, and at key life points, the focus should be healthy lifestyle and prevention of excess weight gain
mappings.literal_source_verification: Teede 2023 Recommendation 3.1.9 (PP). Practice point for adolescents and those without overweight, focusing on healthy lifestyle and excess weight gain prevention.
